card.name: Linking words before rare proper or medical terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as of, at, by and during that come right before a rare or hard-to-spell word. Examples are a complication name (toxic megacolon, hyperuricemia) or a place or institution name (Haifa, Zbraslav, Vienna).

modes.label: Before a complication name
modes.description: 'of' or 'by' just before a named medical complication or sign.

card.writes: It pushes word starts like tu- and ber-, which suggests it prepares the start of a rare word such as tuberculosis or Berlin.
card.plain: It fires on a small linking word when a long, uncommon name or term is about to follow.
